name: Bewitchments and Glamours
summary: In Ironforge, the library is seeking magical works for its shelves. You can help its keepers widen their knowledge by bringing in books that may benefit the collection.

sections.title: A Growing Collection
sections.body: Bring magical works to the library in Ironforge, where each addition can broaden what its keepers know.

faq.answer: The library seeks magical works that may benefit its collection.

faq.q: Where do I bring the magical works?
faq.answer: Bring the magical works to the library in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why are they collecting magical works?
faq.answer: The library says the works will expand its knowledge.
